highlights.title: List or tree for changed files
highlights.text: Press V in a file list, or use the button in its header, to group changed files by folder in Changes and in a commit's files in History. Selecting a folder in Changes selects every file in it.

fixes: The commit message box clears a pre-filled merge message when the merge ends without using Oak's Commit button.
History no longer flashes a flat file list before the tree appears when stepping between commits.

highlights.title: Create theme from current
highlights.text: Preferences > Themes can write a starter theme file from your current colours, so you can see what a custom theme looks like before editing it.

highlights.title: Update progress
highlights.text: Restarting to install an update now shows the installer's progress window instead of the app disappearing.

fixes: Unchanged file content no longer shows the blue current-change tint in the All files tree.
The merge, rebase and cherry-pick banner wraps in narrow panes instead of squeezing its message.
Preferences is taller, keeps controls in place between tabs and stacks checkbox hints under their labels.
Sidebar counts line up on one right edge.

highlights.title: Tab and F6
highlights.text: Tab and Shift+Tab move through the controls inside a pane, including the buttons in file lists and headers. F6 and Shift+F6 switch panes, and Escape on a pane tool returns to its pane.

highlights.title: Tooltips with shortcuts
highlights.text: Toolbar, sidebar and pane buttons show their name and keyboard shortcut in a tooltip.

highlights.title: Simpler branch comparison
highlights.text: A comparison shows the changes since the branches diverged and explains when the target has newer commits. History also has Compare commit with... in its context menu.

highlights.title: Conflict handling
highlights.text: Oak switches to Changes when a merge, rebase or cherry-pick stops with conflicts. Open conflicted files in your merge tool from the banner or a row. Enter no longer resolves a conflict, and Oak warns if conflict markers remain.

fixes: Diff syntax colours meet WCAG AA contrast in the built-in themes.
Escape exits a comparison or file history that has no commits.
The history menu's checkout and compare suggestions handle branches that have a local counterpart.

highlights.title: Faster file history
highlights.text: Stepping through a file's history now loads only that file's diff, so each commit appears much sooner.

fixes: File history shows a loading state instead of briefly drawing the previous list as a single lane.
The commit preview reloads when file history starts or ends.

highlights.title: All files tree in History
highlights.text: Browse a commit's full snapshot as a tree next to its changed files. Press T to switch between Changed and All files, and open any file's content in the diff view.

highlights.title: File history
highlights.text: Pick a file to filter the History graph to the commits that touched it.

highlights.title: Git settings
highlights.text: A new Preferences page covers line endings, editor, merge and diff tools, and opens your git config.

fixes: Left in the sidebar moves to the parent row.
History navigation status sits at the top of the graph and toasts appear at the top right.
Commit file content loads faster through caching and a single Git process.
Command palette titles are shorter, with the commit subject shown as detail.

highlights.title: Working changes in History
highlights.text: Uncommitted changes appear as a read-only row at the top of the graph, named after the current branch, with their files and diffs in the details pane.

highlights.title: Copy from any list
highlights.text: Ctrl+C copies the focused item: relative file paths, a commit hash or a branch name. Ctrl+Shift+C copies the alternate: full file paths, or the commit hash for a branch. Every copy shows a confirmation.

highlights.title: Copy from the diff
highlights.text: Select text in a diff and copy it, or copy the selected lines (or as a patch with Ctrl+Shift+C) without line numbers or signs.

fixes: Commit and comparison file lists now have a context menu with Copy file name, relative path and full path.
File menus match across lists: Changes adds Open file and Show in Explorer next to a Copy submenu.
Text selection in the diff is reliable.

highlights.title: Resize panes with the keyboard
highlights.text: Press Shift+Alt+arrow keys to move the divider of the focused pane. The Layout menu is replaced by a Sidebar toggle in the toolbar, and clicking a divider still works with the same keys.

highlights.title: Zoom with Ctrl+scroll
highlights.text: Hold Ctrl and scroll to step through the zoom levels. A small indicator shows the level with a Reset button. Turn it off in Preferences > Appearance.

highlights.title: Open pull request from history
highlights.text: Right-click a local branch tip in History to open its pull request page, the same as in the sidebar.

fixes: Current branch only no longer shows no commits when the default branch is checked out.
Comparing branches shows a banner above the graph with an Exit comparison button.
The history context menu opens without waiting on Git.

highlights.title: Compare branches without checking out
highlights.text: Right-click any local or remote branch and choose Compare with a target. The graph lists only the commits the branch introduced, and you can select an earlier commit to review the branch at that point.

highlights.title: History scope: current branch only
highlights.text: The History scope menu can now show only the current branch's own commits, without the default branch's merges and the history from before it branched. Current branch + full history restores the whole ancestry.

highlights.title: Commit with nothing staged
highlights.text: With a message and unstaged changes, Commit offers to stage the changed files first. New files are included only if you tick the box, and Don't ask again turns on automatic staging in Preferences.

highlights.title: Adjustable diff context
highlights.text: Show more or less code around changes with the context buttons in the diff header, or the whole file with Ctrl+Shift+W.

highlights.title: Open pull requests
highlights.text: Open a branch's pull request page from the command palette or the branch menu. After pushing a new branch, Oak offers to open it.

highlights.title: Focus mode with F11
highlights.text: Press F11, or use the toolbar's expand button, to fill the window with the focused history graph or code area. Press it again to restore your layout, focus and pane sizes. In expanded history, Enter opens the selected commit's code, and Alt+PageUp/PageDown move between files.

highlights.title: More consistent shortcuts
highlights.text: Shortcuts now run through one scoped system. Commands are ignored while a dialog or menu is open, and when an expanded layout or a running Git operation blocks one, Oak says why instead of doing nothing.

fixes: Ctrl+Shift+A stages everything from inside a diff instead of selecting all lines.
Diff shortcuts such as N and P follow the typed character, so they work on alternative keyboard layouts.

highlights.title: Optional Vim-style navigation
highlights.text: Enable Vim-style navigation in Preferences to use h/j/k/l alongside the arrows in lists, diffs and menus. Search fields and other text inputs keep normal typing behaviour.

highlights.title: Explicit search across panes
highlights.text: Use / or Ctrl+F to search the focused list. Find changed files with a searchable picker, keep branch and history queries while moving between matches, and see when no further matches remain.

highlights.title: Diff controls from the keyboard
highlights.text: Ctrl+Shift+D switches between Inline and Side by side while keeping your place and selection. Shift+Left/Right scrolls horizontally; Vim navigation also supports Shift+H/L.

highlights.title: Fewer permanent toolbar actions
highlights.text: Fetch, Pull and Push stay close at hand. Refresh, terminal and Explorer actions move into More actions; Stash changes is available from the Changes menu, commands and its existing shortcut.

highlights.title: Refreshed Oak branding
highlights.text: A flat Git-tree symbol is used for the app icon and welcome screen.

fixes: Left stays on a Changes file row instead of focusing its Stage and Discard buttons.
Tab from a search field enters its owning list. F6 and Shift+F6 follow pane order and stay within active dialogs and menus.
The current branch tip ring has more room beside the graph row's focus marker.

highlights.title: Compare commits and branches
highlights.text: Select two commits in order to compare Before and After, or compare your current branch against any local or remote branch. Choose Changes since branching for a PR-style view, or Compare snapshots for the exact differences between tips.

highlights.title: Find your branches faster
highlights.text: Current branch and Recently used keep useful branches close at hand. The Branches menu lets you sort by name or latest commit and hide branches whose upstream is gone, with choices saved per repository.

highlights.title: Follow your current branch
highlights.text: The checked-out branch's first-parent path stays clear while other graph lines and dots use muted colours. Toggle Emphasize current branch from the graph header or background menu.

highlights.title: Search keyboard shortcuts
highlights.text: Press Ctrl+/ to search shortcuts by action, category or key combination, and narrow the list with a category filter.

fixes: Opening an old branch shows its commit details immediately and automatically loads enough history to reveal it. Slow loads offer Cancel, and failed loads offer Retry.
Selecting another comparison endpoint silently replaces After while preserving Before, without repeated notification toasts.
Right-click targets one commit without starting a comparison, and right-clicking elsewhere replaces an open menu immediately. Checkout choices and Copy actions use compact submenus where useful.
Muted graph dots are solid and match their connecting lines, so edges do not show through them.

highlights.title: Choose your diff layout
highlights.text: Review files inline or side by side. Automatic adapts to the available pane width, and the compact file-header menu remembers your choice.

highlights.title: Spot the exact edits
highlights.text: Word-level highlights show changed words, numbers and punctuation alongside the existing syntax colours.

highlights.title: Move through changes with confidence
highlights.text: Previous/next arrows, a change counter and a subtle current-change marker help you stay oriented. N/P keyboard navigation remains available.

highlights.title: See what changed after an update
highlights.text: A quiet update notice links to release highlights. Reopen them anytime from Preferences → General or the What’s new in Oak command.

fixes: History details and file diffs update together without flashing a loading panel. Recent previews are cached, with delayed progress and Retry for failed loads.
For a single change, navigation arrows stay disabled while any changed lines are visible. Scroll the change completely away to reveal it again; disabled arrows look inactive.

highlights.title: Syntax colours in diffs
highlights.text: Language-aware syntax highlighting follows your theme and can be turned off in Preferences → Diffs.

highlights.title: Automatic updates
highlights.text: Oak downloads new versions in the background and offers a restart when an update is ready.

highlights.title: Oak for Windows
highlights.text: Review history, stage changes, manage branches and work with Git from a keyboard-friendly desktop app.
